extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic Sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A sequence where each term differs from the previous by a constant difference d; nth term aₙ = a₁ + (n-1)d

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A sequence where each term is multiplied by a constant ratio r; nth term aₙ = a₁·r^(n-1)

extracted_concepts.name: Exponents
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operations involving powers of a base; laws include aᵐ·aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ and (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse of exponentiation; log_a(x) = y ⟺ aʸ = x; change of base: log_a(x) = log_b(x)/log_b(a)

extracted_concepts.name: Complex Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers of the form z = a + bi where i² = -1; modulus |z| = √(a²+b²), argument arg(z) = arctan(b/a)

extracted_concepts.name: Polar Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Representation of complex numbers as z = r(cos θ + i sin θ)

extracted_concepts.name: Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mappings from domain to range characterized by intercepts, symmetry, and transformations

extracted_concepts.name: Quadratic Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions of the form f(x) = ax² + bx + c with vertex at x = -b/(2a)

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions of the form f(x) = P(x)/Q(x) with vertical asymptotes where Q(x) = 0

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions of the form f(x) = aˣ, including the natural exponential f(x) = eˣ

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions of the form g(x) = log_a(x), including the natural logarithm g(x) = ln(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometric Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions sin, cos, tan defined on angles; tan x = sin x / cos x

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometric Identities
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fundamental identities such as sin²x + cos²x = 1 and double angle formulas sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x

extracted_concepts.name: Radian Measure
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Angle measure where arc length s = rθ and sector area A = ½r²θ

extracted_concepts.name: Vectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantities with magnitude and direction in 2D and 3D; characterized by unit vectors

extracted_concepts.name: Dot Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar product of two vectors: a · b = |a||b|cos θ

extracted_concepts.name: Cross Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector product in 3D: |a × b| = |a||b|sin θ

extracted_concepts.name: Lines and Planes in 3D
aliases: 三维空间中的直线与平面
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Parametric equations of lines and vector equations of planes in three-dimensional space

extracted_concepts.name: Limits
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value a function approaches as the input approaches a certain point

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A property of functions where limits exist and equal the function value; prerequisite for differentiability

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The process of finding derivatives using first principles, chain rule, product rule, quotient rule, and implicit differentiation

extracted_concepts.name: Chain Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rule for differentiating composite functions: d/dx[f(g(x))] = f'(g(x))·g'(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rule for differentiating products: (uv)' = u'v + uv'

extracted_concepts.name: Quotient Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rule for differentiating quotients: (u/v)' = (u'v - uv')/v²

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Technique for differentiating equations where y is not explicitly solved for x

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse of differentiation; includes indefinite and definite integrals, substitution, and parts

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration: ∫[a,b] f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a) where F' = f

extracted_concepts.name: Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The study of random events using sample spaces, events, and independent events

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event given another event has occurred; P(A|B) = P(A∩B)/P(B)

extracted_concepts.name: Bayes' Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Formula for updating probabilities: P(A|B) = P(B|A)·P(A)/P(B)

extracted_concepts.name: Binomial Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability distribution of the number of successes in n independent Bernoulli trials

extracted_concepts.name: Normal Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Continuous probability distribution characterized by mean and standard deviation; bell-shaped curve

extracted_concepts.name: Central Limit Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The sampling distribution of the mean approaches a normal distribution as sample size increases

extracted_concepts.name: Hypothesis Testing
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statistical procedure using z-test, t-test, and χ²-test to evaluate claims about population parameters

extracted_concepts.name: Descriptive Statistics
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summary measures including mean, median, mode, standard deviation, box plots, and cumulative frequency

extracted_concepts.name: Discriminant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ = b² - 4ac determines the nature of roots of a quadratic equation

extracted_concepts.name: Asymptotes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines that a curve approaches but never touches; vertical where Q(x)=0, horizontal by degree comparison

extracted_concepts.name: Transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Modifications of function graphs including translations, reflections, and stretches

extracted_concepts.name: Related Rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Application of differentiation to find rates of change of related quantities

extracted_concepts.name: Confidence Intervals
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Range of values likely to contain a population parameter with a specified confidence level
